quarterly_data.quarter: Solstice Advanced Materials press release: Solstice Announces $49 Million Investment to Expand (10-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Solstice announced plans to invest $49 million to expand research and development capabilities at its Buffalo, New York facility, establishing a next-generation innovation platform at its Buffalo research campus: expanded capabilities for refrigerant and thermal management research, enhanced toxicological testing, and the construction of a lab for advanced energy storage materials. The company says the investment is intended to strengthen its innovation capabilities supporting refrigerants, advanced cooling and other high-growth applications; it has committed to creating 12 new full-time positions at the facility by June 2027. CEO David Sewell: the projects 'will expand the site's capabilities in areas aligned with long-term growth trends.'
quarterly_data.figure: $49 million R&D investment at Buffalo, New York; 12 new full-time positions by June 2027
